purpose: technical activation, conditional prediction errors and whole-request cost; no strength evidence

corpus.selection: first 12 full-real-history roots; reused diagnostic inputs, no independent confirmation claim

observe.samples: prediction events 1,2,32,128 of each kind per root; retain all sampled outcomes
observe.reference: independent recursive TT-off unpruned qsearch at assigned nominal depth; 100000 entered-node guard per conditional sample; exact mate normalization to real ply

cost.rotation: round plus root index plus offset modulo three
cost.allRetriesHelpersAndAborts: included in request telemetry and wall/process CPU

resources: one BelowNormal hidden JVM at a time; ActiveProcessorCount=2; Xms256m Xmx768m; 30-second per-request safety limit; 15-minute runner timeout
analysis: all outputs/failures retained; warmups excluded from aggregates; approximate root-level cost spread, complete requests, process CPU, live-thread allocation, GC/JIT and heap; no Elo inference; conditional sample errors are neither population calibration nor automatically correctness defects
next: diagnose material integrity or composition issues; preserve v1 if any new formulation/run is necessary
